prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1113; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented with neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. Symptoms included pain radiating into the trapezius region, occipital headaches, and muscle guarding on palpation of the cervical paraspinal muscles. Cervical range of motion was reduced in flexion, extension, and rotation to the left. Neurological examination showed intact motor strength and reflexes, with no objective radicular findings.

Over the course of 23 visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization, and postural education. Modalities including moist heat and intermittent cold were used for symptom control during the early phase of care. Home exercise instruction was reinforced at each visit.

By the end of the treatment course, the patient reported substantial improvement in neck pain and headache frequency. Range of motion had returned to near-normal limits, with mild residual stiffness on end-range rotation. The patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
